warm.instruct: A warm, friendly young woman in her twenties. Soft, bright and gently playful, with a smile in her voice. Calm, encouraging and clear, at a relaxed natural pace. Cozy and caring, never childish, never breathy or whispery.

en.text: Hey, it's me, Ami. I'm so glad you're here. Let's take today one small step at a time, and I'll keep track of the rest for you.

de.text: Hey, ich bin's, Ami. Schön, dass du da bist. Lass uns den Tag Schritt für Schritt angehen, und ich behalte den Rest für dich im Blick.
